newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil resumes Statfjord, Gullfaks oil loadings.
newsitem.headline: Statoil resumes Statfjord, Gullfaks oil loadings.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS said on Tuesday it had begun crude loadings at offshore buoys at the North Sea Statfjord and Gullfaks oilfields.
"There are five tankers waiting at the fields. The first one connected up a few minutes ago and the others are heading into position," Statoil spokesman Odd Jan Lange said.
Lange said output at Statfjord B and C installations, which had been reduced due to burgeoning storage capacity, would gradually be brought back to normal levels as the oil was offloaded.
Production at Statfjord A and the Gullfaks development had not been disrupted.
Hurricane-force winds and high waves have prevent shuttle tankers from loading since Sunday. Lange said the weather forecast was good until early afternoon on Wednesday.
